acquisition method: The data-dependent acquisition (Top 20) was carried out using MS survey scans in the 350~1700 m/z range with 70,000 mass resolution.
cleavage agent: After trypsin digestion, the samples were desalted and dried by vacuum.
collision energy: The normalized collision energy was 27 eV.
instrument: LC–MS/MS analysis was carried out using the Q Exactive Plus mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) coupled to the Easy nLC1200 nano-flow UPLC.
ionization type: The sample was atomized using the nanoESI source.
labeling: To generate a reference proteome map of the potato chloroplast, we employed gel-free analyses followed by tandem mass spectrometry
reduction reagent: The dried pellet containing chloroplast proteins was resuspended by an appropriate volume of lysis buffer (1% SDS, 100 mM Tris-HCl, 100 mM DTT, pH 8.0).
